title: Move: pull repeated handler code into a helper
prompt: The Ordering domain event handlers that publish order-status integration events all repeat the same buyer lookup and publish code. Pull it into one shared helper.
done: the handlers share one helper for the buyer lookup and publish, with behaviour unchanged

expect.text: The model still has each handler publishing its integration event: the work still happens, through the helper. (No queries are modelled on these handlers, so none is expected.)
The helper is modelled only if it is a kind of element the model describes, such as a domain service; a plain helper class stays out of the model.
